accepted: All-time volume-uniform Gaussian spatial approximation on infinite-dimensional onsite blocks; reverse additionally proves inverse and full-generator bounded-commutator approximation by independently retaining every crossing term.
authorship: Separate skeptical model agent after freeze; not external peer review.

external_source_review.scope: Section2 strong/weak calculus, Section3 Eq71-73 commutator recurrence and Theorem3.1, Section4 Theorem4.1 and norm-volume versus time-continuity distinction

limitations: Directions use distinct collars, durations and numerical instances; their specific regional sizes/errors cannot be mixed.
The telescoping decomposition has exponential diameter control but does not certify the existing exponential support-cardinality interaction norm.
Failed cardinality upper majorant is not actual divergence or impossibility of every connected-support decomposition.
Local residual/inverse approximation does not give later-diagonal stability, exact source inversion, homogeneous numerical gap or continuum construction.
Norm finite-volume limit for an observable does not imply norm continuity in time on all local B(H) or norm convergence of full propagators.
next_loop_recommendation: Freeze a candidate connected-support or time-partition construction aimed at the original exponential support-cardinality norm, then establish that norm with all ordered multiplicities or identify the precise failed certificate. Do not relabel the proved diameter norm as the required stability norm.
review_notes: The all-time recurrence counts chains of successive overlapping stars, not a naive growing-support Dyson series.
Forward Duhamel factor r(2M)^m/m! includes the leading commutator factor 2 and final time integration; summed chain count <=16^m.
Forward m<=R chains fit in l1 radius 2R+1; reverse a boundary anchor with coordinate R+1 needs at least R intervening star steps.
Reverse Gaussian first-moment and Mills bounds integrate the entire tail and correctly yield the two error constants.
The reverse graph refinement is direction-origin, accepted after review rather than falsely called independently duplicated.
Independently inspected primary arXiv:1410.8174v1 sections 2,3 and4: theorem hypotheses permit separable infinite-dimensional onsite spaces; geometry-specific constants are derived in these reports.
supported_claims: Strong interaction-picture commutator recursion handles unbounded onsite terms with bounded complete-star interactions.
Each site belongs to at most four stars; sixteen is a safe succeeding-anchor count including repeated anchors.
Forward l1 collars give residual error/r <=2^-R exp((64Ms)^2/2); s=4,R=64 cap error <2^-42 using 374660 complete factors.
Reverse cube collars give epsilon_R and kappa_R controlling residual and inverse norms; s=2,R=40 cap errors <2e-7 r and <1e-7 r with 74088 factors.
Reverse explicitly bounds all boundary commutators <=epsilon_R, giving full commutator error <=2epsilon_R and graph-operator approximation <=kappa_R+2epsilon_R.
The localized reverse inverse preserves the actual finite-volume graph domain and retains the AB2 full-source contraction after localization.
